name: Tibalt's glass sword
description: A sword of shimmering, colorful glass that tears holes between realms and planes.

timeline.summary: Tibalt opens a portal to a fiery realm with a glass sword and leaves Kaya with the trolls.
timeline.quote: With that, he stepped through the portal.

relations.note: Tibalt wields the sword that rips open the doors between realms.
relations.quote: in the other, he held that sword of shimmering, colorful glass

pages_say.description: A glass sword with a shifting spectrum of colors that opens a portal to Immersturm.
A sword of shimmering, colorful glass that tears holes between realms and planes.
